data.title: Copayment exemption for 2025 rejected (Zuzahlungsbefreiung 2025 – Ablehnung)
data.summary: The Allgemeine Musterkasse rejected Mara Beispiel's application for exemption from copayments (Zuzahlungsbefreiung) for 2025, because her copayments did not reach the burden limit (Belastungsgrenze) of €748.20 (2% of annual gross income) under § 62 SGB V.
data.explanation: Your statutory health insurer has turned down your request to be exempted from copayments in 2025, because your payments so far stayed below the 2% income threshold. You may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, or have it recorded in person, if you disagree — the app will show until when you can do this. If you take no action, the rejection becomes final. If your income or expected copayments change, you could also consider reapplying later in the year. It may help to check the calculation of your gross income if you think it is wrong.

key_facts.label: Burden limit (Belastungsgrenze)
key_facts.quote: Die Summe Ihrer Zuzahlungen hat die Belastungsgrenze von 2 % der jährlichen Bruttoeinnahmen (748,20 €) nicht erreicht (§ 62 SGB V).

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch)
items.action: If you disagree with the rejection, submit a written objection (Widerspruch) to the Allgemeine Musterkasse, or have it recorded in person, by the deadline shown.
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Allgemeinen Musterkasse erhoben werden.

remedy.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Allgemeinen Musterkasse erhoben werden.
